request_reviews.rationale: Facts hold: 9+9 rows publish the printed bracketed cost. Two problems. (1) The must-fail test misses the known real-error class. pipeline/column_validation.py says C107 real errors are 'source dash extracted as negative', and this fund's own retired verdict was exactly that (American Academy '160 - -' stored as -3,000). The repair must include a test that a printed dash published as a negative cost still fails, next to the positive-to-negative test. (2) C107 is a monitor ('negative cost can be legitimate but should be monitored'). Narrowing it to 'differs from the printed line' changes what it compares, so the owner should see it as an acceptance change; the code comment also forbids row-local cuts without new evidence. Not needed for clearance: the accepted DS-FUNDLOOP-C107-1989817 already closes both findings.

The 41 rows are correctly read. The AVSC must-fail test (rate printed and dropped) is right but not enough. The investigator's own observation equity-section-rows-published-as-loans says X02 caught the LC8 class error (a Preferred Equity row published as a loan, no printed rate). It also warns that a no-rate-printed exemption would clear such a row. The repair needs a second must-fail test: a row printed under an equity heading (or with no debt line) and published as a LOAN with no rate still fails. Otherwise move the class signal to the proposed section-heading check first. Without that, the repair weakens detection. The accepted DS-FUNDLOOP-X02-1989817 already closes the finding.
